goal: Prevent node crashes and shutdown hangs by deferring background chainstate compaction when disk space is low
Skip periodic compaction entirely for in-memory databases
Log compaction start and finish events by default
agreement: Support without stated reasons, all suggestions addressed (stickies-v, optout21)
Suggested skipping compaction on low disk space rather than just warning (andrewtoth)

categories.name: validation
why: P2 because it fixes a regression causing node crashes or hangs on shutdown when disk margins are tight
Compaction can double disk usage, so checking space first prevents filling the disk
